text.content:
Ripperdoc, surgeon, and the one person in Arroyo both sides leave alone.

Role: Medtech (Medtech 8) and Tech
Where to find them: A clinic above a Santo Cruz pharmacy, Arroyo
Known for: Writing the chrome, medicine and gear chapters of Sable's rulebook

She runs a clinic above a pharmacy in Santo Cruz and is the only person in Arroyo that 6th Street and the Valentinos both leave alone. Her nights are industrial accidents, gunshots and kids who chipped in too young: the same three things, in changing ratios. She has opinions about your chrome, and about the guy on Jig-Jig Street whose work she keeps fixing.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 04, 11
